title: Mcqueen's Heropack
description: A Palladium add-on packed with heroes and villains from The Incredibles, DC, and beyond — each with fully-realized powers, skill trees, and custom gear.
body:
McQueen's Hero Pack
A Palladium add-on packed with heroes and villains from The Incredibles, DC, and beyond — each with fully-realized powers, skill trees, and custom gear.
McQueen's Hero Pack brings a roster of iconic super-powered characters to Minecraft, built on the Palladium superpower framework. Every power comes with its own progression tree, unique abilities, and thematic ways to obtain it — from crafting relics to being struck by lightning.
Heroes & Villains

Suit up as characters including Mr. Incredible, Elastigirl, Frozone, Syndrome and the rest of the Incredibles roster, alongside Raven, Static Shock, Metro Man, Thor, Wonder Woman, Captain America, Soldier Boy, Killer Frost, Shazam, and many more. 

Features

Deep skill trees — unlock and upgrade each power your way. Nothing is handed to you; earn flight, heat vision, super speed, enhanced health, and signature abilities as you progress.

Signature abilities — Elastigirl's directional stretch-glide and stretching punches, Metro Man's speed and time-stop, Syndrome's Zero Point beam and Omnidroid summons, Raven's teleportation, and more.

Custom dimension — travel to Azarath, a peaceful always-daylight utopia of rolling hills, lakes, and endless flowers, via Raven's Gateway ability.(more coming soon)

Unique power sources — craft the Frozen Heart, get struck by lightning while poisoned, assemble Metro Man's hair strand, or dig up ancient relics.
Custom gear — hero suits, shields with real durability, capes, and themed items, each with their own crafting recipes and advancements.

REQUIRES PALLADIUM TIMESTOP CLOCK'S VERSION MUST BE 4.4.0 OR ELSE IT WILL NOT WORK ON SERVERS!!
